newsitem.title: USA: Scitex hires Clal chief for strategic plan.
newsitem.headline: Scitex hires Clal chief for strategic plan.

text.p: Scitex Corp Ltd said Sunday that it has retained the Boston Consulting Group to help review "ongoing business and management processes" and the formulation of its strategic plan.

The company, which last week reported third quarter losses had widened to $3.53 per share, said also that it has named Mendy Erad, managing director of Clal Electronics Industries Ltd, as vice chairman of its board.
Erad, a director of Scitex since 1995, will succeed John Georges, the company said. Georges' resignation was announced last week.
The company said Erad will help Chief Executive Yoav Chelouche on a restructuring plan for the company's Graphic Arts Group and on developing a strategic plan for the company as a whole.
